DeterminationBasis: The policy or rule set governing the contemplated consequence is a mandatory governing-state predicate where applicable. T01-001 requires all mandatory governing-state predicates to be present and identifiable before consequential evaluation, while T01-004 fails closed when a mandatory governing predicate cannot be established. Together they cover positive identification and missing-policy failure without requiring a new test.

T05-001 establishes identifiable provenance and admissibility, T05-004 preserves uncertainty when provenance or integrity properties are unavailable, and T05-006 establishes independent package re-hashability. None directly requires each material Evidence Object to possess a stable evidence identifier. Stable evidence-object identity therefore remains a distinct test obligation.
